senses.gloss: a person who does not belong to a particular group or place
a person or competitor not expected to win
senses.example: The small company was an outsider in the bidding process.

example_translations.zh_TW: 這家小公司在投標過程中並不被看好。
example_translations.ja_JP: その小さな会社は入札プロセスでは勝ち目の薄い存在だった。
example_translations.ko_KR: 그 작은 회사는 입찰 과정에서 승산이 낮은 후보였다.
example_translations.vi_VN: Công ty nhỏ đó là bên ít được kỳ vọng thắng trong quá trình đấu thầu.
example_translations.th_TH: บริษัทขนาดเล็กนั้นเป็นผู้ที่ไม่ถูกคาดว่าจะชนะในกระบวนการประมูล

definition_translations.vi_VN: người ít có cơ hội thắng
definition_translations.th_TH: ม้านอกสายตา

translations.th_TH: คนนอกทั่วไป
